name: Echoes of You
source:
Echoes of You is a point n click visual novel about leaving behind a loved one and remember them for life. Play as a Vivienne, a vampire, who decides to visit her girlfriend's house one last time.

[from [url=https://klaiis.itch.io/echoes-of-you]Itch.io[/url]]
